en: The image is a vintage postcard featuring a hand-colored photograph of a canal with docked sailboats, with cobblestone streets, classic European architecture, and a notable dome-topped building in the background. There is also an inset black-and-white photograph of three formally dressed people on the left side of the card. In the upper right, there is Swedish text printed on the card.
